about: Hockey's defaults, as data (docs/PLAN-start-a-game-gpt.md track L, L1): a sport's standard scoring, categories, lineup slots and locks, and the game specs a sport's Make it a game starts from instead of asking the bot. Stat keys are Hockey's (src/lib/sports/hockey.ts): skaters' and goalies' in one table, since a key is unique in the sport (a skater scores goals, G; a goalie allows them, GA). Slots take its positions or position groups. The specs are in the game spec's shape (A1's schema, on the engine branch); slots and categories aren't in that schema yet (L4 adds them), so they're kept beside it for the spec to read.

scoring.source: Yahoo's default head-to-head points (help.yahoo.com/kb/SLN6815.html): skaters, then goalies

categories.source: Yahoo's standard 10 categories (rotisserie and head-to-head categories): six for skaters, four for goalies

season.about: A season-long league: draft a full roster, set a daily lineup, play someone head to head each week.

short.about: One game, a series or a team's next few: everyone drafts a few players, every one of them scores, most points wins.

pickem.about: Each game, before it starts: who wins? A point for each one right, most points wins (a tie counts for nobody).

pickAFew.about: Each game, before it starts: pick three players. 3 points for each one who has the most points (goals and assists) in the game (tied, each of them), most points wins.

ask.ask: Pick three: who has the most points (goals and assists)?
